local function log(msg)
    local f = io.open(LOG_FILE, "a")
    if f then
        f:write(os.date("[%H:%M:%S] ") .. msg .. "\n")
        f:close()
    end
end

local function readFile(path)
    local f = io.open(path, "r")
    if not f then return "" end
    local content = f:read("*a") or ""
    f:close()
    return content
